description: The plot is a line graph that illustrates the loss values of four different models over a series of steps. The x-axis represents the step number, ranging from 0 to 60000, and the y-axis represents the loss value, which is on a logarithmic scale from 1.2 x 10^1 to 1.1 x 10^1. The four models are represented by different colored lines: Ex1 Loss (blue solid line), Ex2 Loss (green dashed line), Ex1 Validation Loss (blue dotted line), and Ex2 Validation Loss (green dash-dot line). The Ex1 Loss starts with the highest loss value at step 0 and decreases sharply, then levels off. The Ex2 Loss starts lower than the Ex1 Loss, decreases more gradually, and also levels off. The Ex1 Validation Loss and Ex2 Validation Loss follow a similar trend to their respective Ex1 and Ex2 Loss lines, with the Ex1 Validation Loss starting higher and decreasing more sharply than the Ex2 Validation Loss.
